body.fit_card: Scored this butterfly baby tee on depop for only $18 and I am so obsessed with the pastel Y2K vibe. I love balancing out the girly print with baggy dark wash denim and chunky boots for that effortless noughties look. It’s also super cute tucked into khaki trousers with a black denim jacket thrown over top when I want something a little more earthy.
body.outfit_suggestion:
Outfit 1: Pair the Y2K Baby Tee with the baggy straight-leg jeans, dark wash for a classic noughties silhouette. Add the black combat boots and the black crossbody bag to ground the pastel top, and loop the brown leather belt through the jeans for a subtle contrast. 

Outfit 2: Style the Y2K Baby Tee tucked into the wide-leg khaki trousers for a softer, slightly earthy blend of styles. Layer the vintage black denim jacket over top for structure, and slip into the chunky white sneakers to keep the look casual, comfortable, and effortlessly coordinated.
